explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/856 ('(log N)^{0.438} ≤ f_3(N) … for all large N') and the abstract of arXiv:2512.20055, which gives (log N)^{log μ_k^S − o(1)} ≤ f_k(N) with μ_k^S the sunflower-free capacity; for k = 3 the known bound μ_3^S ≥ 1.551 yields the exponent log 1.551 ≈ 0.4389. The Lean statement: for every ε > 0, (log N)^{log 1.551 − ε} ≤ f 3 N for all large N. This implies the page's 0.438 bound. Faithful.
